gbm_population_evidence.quote: Glioma; Astrocytoma; Anaplastic Astrocytoma; Oligodendroglioma; Glioblastoma Multiforme
Patients having past history of histologically proven glioma.

candidate_evidence.quote: [DIAGNOSTIC_TEST] PSMA PET-CT: Prostate Specific Membrane Antigen PET-CT
Investigators, therefore, aim to identify whether Ga-68 PSMA PET-CT has better diagnostic accuracy in the detection of recurrent gliomas than conventional imaging modalities.

role_evidence.quote: Detection of sensitivity and specificity of 68Ga PSMA-11 PET-CT to diagnose disease recurrence in gliomas

agents.drug_class_hint: Ga-68 labelled PSMA-11 PET imaging tracer (diagnostic radiopharmaceutical)
arms: Efficiency of 68 Ga-PSMA-11 PET-CT in detection of recurrent gliomas

source_quote.quote: Correlation between PSMA expression in histopathology specimen (using IHC) and SUVmax of recurrent lesion on 68Ga- PSMA PET-CT scan.

coder_notes: Phase NA diagnostic imaging study; no therapeutic agent. 18F-FDG PET is used as a comparator imaging in a secondary outcome but is not a registered intervention, so not listed (R9). Exclusion 'Any brain primary other than high grade glioma' suggests high-grade only, but conditions list several glioma types including Glioblastoma Multiforme.
